To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a good image deblurring model should favor clear images, and that a data driven discriminant image prior can be learned to achieve such a goal.

1) we formulate the image deblurring prior as a binary classification problem, 2) we develop an efficient algorithm based on half quadratic splitting method for optimizing the proposed model, and 3) the proposed method is able to deblur natural, text and face images as well as low illumination images.
a discriminative image prior can be learned from data to favor clear images over blurry ones.

a good image model is not only able to capture the structure of an image, but also to distinguish clear images from blurred ones, which is a key component in many computer vision tasks.
